summary.name: Snap
summary.one_liner: Snap is a free Mac app that assigns keyboard shortcuts to dock apps and lets you set custom shortcuts to launch or peek at apps.
use_cases: Open dock apps with keyboard shortcuts
Set custom hotkeys for frequently used apps
Quickly glance at running app windows
Reduce mouse use while working on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Snap automatically assigns keyboard shortcuts to apps pinned in the dock, using a modifier key (command, option, control, or shift) plus the number keys. For example, command+1 opens the first dock app. Shortcuts reset automatically when dock apps are rearranged or added. Users can also set a custom shortcut for any app on the Mac. An app peeking feature shows an app window with one press of a shortcut and hides it with another press.
notable: Automatic shortcuts for dock apps using modifier keys plus number keys
App peeking: toggle an app window with one shortcut
Listed as freeware in awesome-mac; Lifehacker Download of the Day (June 15, 2011)
caveats: Developer has not provided privacy details or accessibility information on the listing
